meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Centinela (QA) 代理执行安全审计：运行 SIGN IN 与 OWASP Top 10 检查，扫描硬编码密钥，审计依赖漏洞，若有 Solidity 则检查智能合约，最后生成报告到 docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md 并交给 Dev 代理。
howto.when: 当用户输入 `/security-audit` 命令时触发，例如发布前验证安全状态、重大代码变更后、定期安全审查等。

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 运行安全审计
say.note: 生成该目录的审计报告。
执行 SIGN IN、OWASP Top 10 等检查。
对 src/auth/ 进行定向审计。

howto.what_en: Claude invokes Centinela (QA) to run SIGN IN checklist, OWASP Top 10 checks, scan secrets/API keys, audit dependency CVEs, and inspect smart contracts (if Solidity). It writes a report to docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md and hands off findings to the Dev agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /security-audit, e.g., before a release, after significant changes to auth/authz/data handling, or during periodic security reviews.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on src/payments/
say_en.note: Generates an audit report for that directory.
Runs SIGN IN and OWASP Top 10 checks.
Runs a scoped audit on src/auth/.
